purpose: Router signals from Jev 1.13 on the 967 wide reading items (MC-99): pre-hoc signals from the passage and question (J1), and post-hoc signals from the answer B actually gave on each of its two wide draws (J2). No student-model request; no gold reaches Jev.

items.source: The 967 wide reading items of the menu set (data/diagnostic_llm_router/menu_q_v1.json; diagnostic_menu.design_items), in menu-manifest order. Passage and question come from the item's frozen main-v1 reading prompt.

group.instructions: Which kind of question is this, given the passage?

criteria.so_hieu: The question asks for the number or name of an article, clause, point, chapter or section, or for the name of a document (for example 'which clause', 'which article', 'which document regulates'); the answer usually sits in the heading or the lead-in of the passage.
criteria.tinh_toan: The answer must be computed, counted, compared or combined from several numbers or facts in the passage; it is not stated verbatim.
criteria.toan_bo: The question asks for a complete list, all the cases, or the entire content of a provision.
criteria.mot_phan: The passage lists several items or cases, or gives a long provision, and the question asks for only one item, one case or one part of it.
criteria.dieu_kien: The question asks for a condition, a case, a time of application or a consequence, and needs matching several parts of the passage.
criteria.tra_cuu: The answer is a short phrase stated verbatim in one sentence of the passage, such as a subject, a deadline, a stated number or a definition.

asks_designation.instructions: The question asks for the number or name of an article, clause, point, chapter or section, or for the name of a legal document.

needs_computation.instructions: Answering needs counting, arithmetic, comparing or combining several numbers or facts from the passage; the answer is not written verbatim in it.

asks_whole_list.instructions: The question asks for a complete list, all the cases, or the entire content of a provision.

asks_one_part.instructions: The passage lists several items or cases, or gives a long provision, and the question asks for only one item, case or part of it.

asks_condition.instructions: The question asks for a condition, a case, a time of application or a consequence, which needs matching several parts of the passage.

verbatim_short.instructions: The answer is a short phrase written verbatim in one sentence of the passage, such as a subject, a deadline, a stated number or a definition.

passage_insufficient.instructions: The passage does not contain the information needed to answer the question.

answer_correct.instructions: The proposed answer correctly answers the question, according to the passage.

answer_complete.instructions: The proposed answer contains every part that the question asks for.

answer_extra.instructions: The proposed answer adds information that the question does not ask for.

answer_verbatim.instructions: The proposed answer is copied word for word from the passage.

route.credential: the opencode-go key of the local OpenCode auth store, read in the runner process and never written to outputs

analysis.reading_rule: promising when, against the best fixed per-dataset policy on the same items, the pooled score is at least 1.0 point higher, or at most 0.5 points lower at no more than 60% of its mean student-model tokens
